config.retain_mission: Extract durable product and planning knowledge from ideation, planning, and specification work: problem statements, target users, goals, non-goals, requirements, constraints, product decisions, trade-offs, assumptions, open questions, risks, milestones, acceptance criteria, and links between ideas, plans, and implementation specs. Ignore banter, duplicate restatements, transient brainstorming fragments that were rejected, and low-level implementation logs better suited to the implementation bank.
config.observations_mission: Synthesize stable product direction and planning patterns: recurring product goals, user segments, decision rationales, constraints, priority shifts, unresolved risks, and contradictions between plans/specs. Prefer observations that help the main agent turn ideas into high-level plans and plans into actionable specs. Ignore discarded brainstorm branches unless they explain an important decision.
config.reflect_mission: You are a product strategy memory for the main user-facing agent. Ground planning help in remembered goals, decisions, constraints, assumptions, requirements, and spec history. Be strategic, skeptical of weak assumptions, and explicit about open questions or stale plans.
